data.review_body:
I would rate them with 0 stars if there was an option for it.

I returned an item that was not as its description said when I bought it. They don't provide free pre-paid returns anymore, so I shipped it back and paid for it myself.

More than a week later, they said the product I returned is not the same as what I received and rejected and closed my refund request!! which was totally incorrect.

I provided the evidence of postal fee receipt and tracking number and the package itself, and they rejected it again.

I appealed and provided the evidence again and they said they escalated my case to their "Senior" team. I followed up on that case and every time they ask for evidence again and say they haven't decided yet and they would respond to me soon.

It's been 2 weeks and every time I follow up on my case, they ask for the same evidence I have provided 4 times already.

Their service is a total disaster. Don't buy anything from them if you don't want to lose your money on their garbage products and services.

Update: after 5-6 times of follow-up with their customer support, I finally got the info that they haven't received the returned package yet! 
Is it that hard to just inform the customer about that issue at first instead of sending "regret to inform you we are unable to proceed with your refund request" or " found that the proof is not effective enough to prove your claim"?

One item ordered and paid for with two free gifts, sounded good. However one of the gifts, a smartwatch was damaged in transit. Their system to notify is full of inappropriate options and lots of “oops! error something is wrong “. If only 1% of their effort to sell more, was concentrated onto giving good service, when something is wrong, their service would be better.
However it’s not. Worst service I’ve attempted to have in a long time. They should take a leaf out of the Amazon book!
I will never use them again.

data.review_body:
After endless back and forth and this public review, They finally emailed admitting my documents are correct and promised a coupon refund though I still haven't actually received it yet.
Even when it arrives, giving a coupon instead of actual cash is incredibly unfair. I paid real money out of my pocket to return a faulty item. Forcing me to take store credit is just a cheap tactic to make me spend more money with them. I only agreed because they rejected my proof so many times I felt I had no other choice.
I am keeping my 1-star rating. It shouldn’t take a week of arguing, constant document rejections, and a public complaint to get a basic £4.45 refund. The customer service and hassle were disgraceful.
